build.label: c72_diag_mirror
build.evidence_label: diagnostic-build evidence; establishes nothing about the exact c72 binary

capture.mapping_status: hypothesis from D1 (LLDP cadence); confirmed only by D3a below
capture.receive_aggregation: GRO/LRO disabled on the capture interface for the run and restored after, as for the master NIC

common_workload.template: scripts/hardware/lab.json 02_d5_reference (65 READs on the mixed_full schedule plus 64 SELECT/OPERATE cycles per trial)
common_workload.trial_mode: per_trial_cold (each trial is a fresh connection after a cold program load), as in every c72 campaign

D3a_port_mapping.observable: frames received on Vision enp59s0f1np1 during d3_mirror_on_d20, against the switch dev10 TX frame counter and the relay-leg frames seen at the master NIC
D3a_port_mapping.mechanism: sessions 101/102 send every relay-leg frame to dev10; if dev10 is cabled to enp59s0f1np1 the copies arrive there
D3a_port_mapping.falsifier: no relay-leg copies on enp59s0f1np1 while the dev10 TX counter advances; copies are then going elsewhere and D3/E1/E2 stop until the mapping is found
D3a_port_mapping.record: ethtool -i, ip link, interface RX counters before/after on Vision; switch port counters for dev10 before/after

D3b_copy_fidelity.observable: off arm of d3_mirror_on_d20: each request frame sent at the master NIC against its egress copy (leaving toward dev64), and each relay response frame at its ingress copy (arriving from dev64) against the frame delivered at the master NIC
D3b_copy_fidelity.mechanism: with T and padding off the switch forwards relay-leg frames unchanged, so an exact copy equals the external reference at the master NIC
D3b_copy_fidelity.falsifier: any byte difference outside the declared fields (none are declared for the off arm), any copy shorter than its reference, or a missing copy that the switch counters do not account for; the mirror is then not validated and no E1/E2 result is used

D3c_completeness.observable: copies per trial against relay-leg frames at the master NIC, the switch dev64 RX/TX and dev10 TX counters, and tcpdump capture/kernel-drop statistics on the capture interface
D3c_completeness.falsifier: unexplained missing copies, kernel drops, or caplen below frame length
D3c_completeness.reported: counts with denominators per trial and per direction

D3d_mirror_on_vs_off.observable: per arm and transaction class: delivery (exchange counts and verdicts), response sizes, and CLRT, d3_mirror_on_d20 against d3_mirror_off_d20
D3d_mirror_on_vs_off.mechanism: the copy is made in the deparser and queued to dev10; it should not change forwarding or the T release
D3d_mirror_on_vs_off.falsifier: any difference in delivery or response size; for the timed arms, a median CLRT difference above 50 us in any class
D3d_mirror_on_vs_off.untimed_arms: CLRT follows the relay and is reported descriptively, with the across-block spread from the c72 evaluation as context; no pass/fail
D3d_mirror_on_vs_off.order: run before any mirror timing is used

E1_preservation.observable: size_only and combined arms of d3_mirror_on_d20 (4 connections): every relay response at the ingress copy against the padded response at the master NIC; every master request against its egress copy
E1_preservation.tool: scripts/analysis/preservation_check.py (TCP translation, CRC-checked link frames, 63->0 wrap, declared padding only)
E1_preservation.falsifier: any content difference after removing only the declared padding and declared header changes; any unmatched transaction
E1_preservation.label: diagnostic-build evidence (c72_diag_mirror)

E2_first_request.observable: on every fresh connection (48: 16 from the d3 blocks, 32 from e2_first_request_d20), the first master request at the master NIC, its egress copy toward dev64, the relay ACK/response at the ingress copy, and any master retransmission
E2_first_request.mechanism: c72 evidence shows 16/256 fresh connections retransmitting the first request at 206-216 ms; the egress copy shows whether the first copy left the switch toward the relay
classification: no egress copy of the first request: lost before or inside the switch

egress copy present, no relay ACK or response in the ingress copies before the retransmission: lost after switch egress (cable, relay NIC or relay), the narrowest supported location; an egress copy does not prove the relay received it
relay response in the ingress copies, not at the master NIC: lost between switch ingress and the master
E2_first_request.falsifier: none for the location itself; if 0 of 48 connections retransmit, report 0/48 with no location
E2_first_request.note: 48 connections at the c72 rate (16/256) give about 3 expected events; this is a bounded diagnostic, not a rate estimate

stop_rules: unsafe restoration or ownership: stop writes
D3a or D3b fails: stop; no E1/E2 result is used
no rerun-until-pass; a failed block is reported as found
